note: Facilitator cases. Process them in order with ONE log (state carries over: ids seen, channel cumulative amounts). The log's clock is `now`. The channel exists with the given deposit. `expected` is the SettleResponse.extensions.solidarity.info the log returns (null = no entry). Every core SettleResponse field must come back unchanged. Purchase payloads are placeholders: the log does not check them.

key.note: Hardhat/Anvil development account 0. Public. Never fund it.
